title: Conflict repair
learning_outcomes: Explain escalation patterns in the context of conflict repair.
Compare and distinguish accountability and apology in the context of conflict repair.
Apply repair and boundaries in the context of conflict repair.
Evaluate and justify decisions about coercion and safety in the context of conflict repair.

lessons.title: Escalation patterns
lessons.outcome: Explain escalation patterns in the context of conflict repair.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving escalation patterns; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to conflict simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain escalation patterns from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of escalation patterns; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Accountability and apology
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish accountability and apology in the context of conflict repair.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving accountability and apology; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to conflict simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain accountability and apology from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of accountability and apology; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Repair and boundaries
lessons.outcome: Apply repair and boundaries in the context of conflict repair.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving repair and boundaries; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to conflict simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain repair and boundaries from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of repair and boundaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Coercion and safety
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about coercion and safety in the context of conflict repair.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving coercion and safety; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to conflict simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain coercion and safety from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of coercion and safety; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of escalation patterns; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of accountability and apology; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of repair and boundaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of coercion and safety; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
